notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 motorbike ref made specific. U2 SUV is on the right (ref said left), bare-colour replace -> blue pickup truck; v2 mask drops the motorbike mirror fragment. U3 removed a worn shirt -> recolour; v2 mask is the shirt only (mirror/handlebar removed). U4 tuk-tuk canopy belonged to the trailer hitched to U1's motorbike and was 'at the right' -> retargeted to the white minivan in the background (SAM3 v2), payload specific.
